nom: QUIA Collagen Overnight Wrapping Mask - Firmer

avis.texte: After seeing this product featured numerous times, I finally decided to try it for myself—and I’m glad I did. This was my first experience using it, and I’ve included photos of the results: before application, with the mask on, and after removal. I did have the flash on for the before which is why my skin looks SO bright in the one. The application process was straightforward, although peeling off the mask proved a bit challenging and slightly uncomfortable. That said, it wasn’t overly painful. Immediately after use, my skin felt noticeably firmer and more hydrated. While I didn’t achieve the ultra-glowy finish often showcased on social media, I did notice a visible improvement in brightness and overall complexion. The product comes in a relatively small bottle, and since it requires full-face coverage, I plan to use it monthly to make it last longer. While the price point is on the higher side for the quantity, I found it to be effective and a worthwhile addition to a skincare routine. Overall, impressed by how refreshed and smooth my skin felt post-use. It delivered on its claims of hydration and brightness, even if the dramatic glow wasn't quite as pronounced as some online reviews suggest. I would definitely recommend it to others looking to enhance their skincare regimen.

avis.titre: Not really what's advertisedNot really what's advertised
avis.texte: The bottle is small, not full. However, day 1: scrubbed My face added my night cream and then applied this mask. Within a few minutes, my face hardened. I was talking but, my lips and face was stiff as a board! "Maybe I put to much gel on"? Doesn't really specify amount. Woke up: peel off wasn't hard. It did come off in sections. So I used a warm wash cloth to finish cleaning my face. I noticed my chin broke out. Day 5: my skin does have a glow about it. However, no real wrinkle change around the eyes or forehead. I will continue to use until bottle is gone. Im 43, don't wear make up. And my skin is usually clear. Pics: day1, 3, 5

Not sure how this has such high ratings. Kept seeing this on tik tok and found it here. It smells like glue, applies like glue, and peels off like glue. There is no noticeable difference. Like your face looks great with it on because it’s all shiny but once you peel it off in the morning, it’s the same. You have to use a lot when applying & quickly as it dries fast.

This product is amazing on two main levels. 1. I’ve had bad cystic and hormonal acne most of my life (I’m 49 years old now). All that acne left a lot of scarring and dark spots on my face, mostly from the chin up the side of my face - on both sides. I’ve used this mask TWICE and already see a major difference in my skin. Acne scarring is slowly going away. I’ve never found a product that does as good of a job as this mask did after two uses. 2. Peeling off this mask is SO SATISFYING. If you ever put Elmer’s glue all over your hand, let it dry, and peeled it off like you were a snake, this mask is for you. You apply it, let it dry, sleep with in, but the next morning, it peels off so beautifully - this mask works but is also FUN 😆 For me and my skin issues, it totally worked. Great purchase - 10/10

I’m giving it a 4 so far since I’m trying it out tonight but I’m already liking how it applies I will say i recommend getting a rubber application brush to apply it so it applies evenly and once it dries it certainly gives you a nice little shine will update in the morning to tweak my review but so far I’m liking the way it feels it’s quick to dry and makes my skin feel tight yet not dry like some clay masks leave your skin, I will say it has a little odd of a smell but it fades as it dries Update: I love how it helps my skin stay calm after long day after work. And it dries quickly easy to peel off and leaves a nice smooth finish as well. I will certainly be purchasing it as my future skincare routine

avis.titre: Best skin care mask I have ever used
avis.texte: This is the best moisturizing collagen mask I’ve ever had in my life! I wash my face at night and put a medium to thin layer all over my face. I let it set for 15 minutes and then I go to sleep. In the morning, I wake up and my mask feels tight, and it comes off in one piece, almost like the shedding of a snake skin! All day my skin is glowing. It feels hydrated and soft. I will forever be using this mask, I have used it for a few weeks now. My skin is usually sensitive to any change in my routine, but this did nothing but positive things for my skin. No breakouts. The picture that I am attaching is the mask that came off this morning.

Arrived fast, package was sealed and spatula included. I ordered another brand as well to compare after reading reviews for both products. I used it once already, as directed. You'll definitely only get a couple applications (2-3) for the bottle size but I don't feel that's an issue. As it says, apply a thick layer, may take longer than 15 min to dry, when I woke up it came off in one piece no problem no water needed. (Like previous reviews mentioned) You could see some blackheads in the peel after, my skin feels soft and looks much more plump and hydrated. I gave 4 stars bc its a process, after I use it a couple more times I'll update my review. Overall, its a nice addition to my routine, its easy and seems effective. I also didn't notice any smell at all.

avis.titre: The same product but different formulas.
avis.texte: The first bottle I bought was great. No smell. Peeled off easily. The second bottle with the gold band was horrible. It smelled like glue. It hurt peeling it off. My skin was red and dry. It peeled off in pieces and I had to go at it with my fingernails. I won't buy this again from this seller. I just bought it because Amazon is fast.

avis.titre: Woke Up With Glowing, Hydrated Skin
avis.texte: I really enjoyed using this overnight collagen mask. It feels lightweight on the skin and absorbs nicely without feeling sticky. When I wake up in the morning, my skin looks more hydrated, smoother, and refreshed. I noticed my skin feels softer and more plump after consistent use. It gives a healthy glow and works well as part of my nighttime routine. If you’re looking for extra hydration and smoother-looking skin, this is definitely worth trying!

Absolutely love this mask! Im 46 and when I wake up my skin is noticeably smoother, firmer, and super-glowy. Its really easy to peel off (I actually enjoy peeling it) it didn’t irritate my skin at all. My face looked refreshed, hydrated, and plump in the morning. Definitely part of my overnight skin care routine. 💖

avis.titre: Great Product, But Half the Value: Two Half-Empty Bottles in a Row
avis.texte: I'm absolutely loving the way this product makes my skin feel, but my excitement is tempered by a major letdown: the bottle arrives half empty. I initially brushed it off as a one-off mistake, so I returned it and ordered another. Unfortunately, the second bottle was in the same state. Paying full price for half a product is frustrating, to say the least. Hopefully, the company will take notice and adjust their packaging or quality control.
